equity_bridge.item: Non-current financial assets at FVTPL (wealth management products + unlisted investments) at 30 June 2026
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet line 1886; their income is stripped from the flows with interest_income, so the asset goes in the bridge at carrying value

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: 10-year average of the base-case revenue path (-10% FY2026 recovering to +2%); the 6.0% equity CAGR is rejected as a growth proxy because it measures retained earnings in a business whose revenue (FY2023 peak 6,912 -> FY2025 6,286) and store count are contracting
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR +6.0% diverges >30% from EPS 5yr CAGR -2.7% and from owner-FCF 5yr CAGR -2.9%: book value compounds from retention while per-share earnings and cash flow shrink. Not a growth signal.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs are on FY2020/FY2022 -> FY2025. Owner-FCF series (reported FCF less lease principal, lease interest, SBC and interest income): FY2020 ~556, FY2022 579, FY2025 480. Owner-FCF CAGRs are 3-4pp below reported-FCF CAGRs because lease cash (RMB560m -> 894m over FY2020-25) grew faster than operating cash flow: an increasing share of the reported cash generation was going to landlords. FY2025 lease-interest for FY2020 is estimated (~30m) as the kpi series starts FY2022.

scenario_narratives.base: A shrinking but cash-generative multi-brand retailer: FY2026 revenue -10% then a slow recovery to 2% growth, pre-lease EBITDA margin ~25%, lease cash easing from 14.6% to 13.5% of revenue as the store mix upgrades and e-commerce grows. Owner FCF settles around RMB400-450m, ~RMB0.65/share, against an RMB650m net cash pile.
scenario_narratives.bull: Consumption recovery from 2027 plus a successful brand consolidation and livestreaming channel shift: revenue back to 3-4% growth, pre-lease margin 26.5%, lease ratio 13%. The upside axis is margin and channel mix, not store growth.
scenario_narratives.bear: Structural same-store decline and department-store channel erosion: revenue compounds down 27% over six years, markdowns compress the pre-lease margin to 22.5%, rent ratio rises to 15%, run-rate owner FCF ~RMB200m. The company survives on its balance sheet but the dividend is funded from cash, not earnings.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the owner cash flow that remains after landlords are paid - lease principal plus interest of ~RMB0.9bn/yr sits in financing and would otherwise flatter reported FCF by 55-60%. Growth is modelled as negative-then-flat because the store base and the end market are both contracting; the case for the shares is the cash yield on a ~RMB1.4bn ex-cash enterprise value, bounded by whether cost-cutting can keep holding margins while revenue falls. Discount at an RMB-built 9.5% with risk carried in a 30% bear weight, and cap the terminal at 12x owner FCF.
key_risks_to_valuation: Same-store sales decline persists beyond FY2027: every -1pp of long-run revenue growth is worth roughly 8-10% of the base value
Lease ratio does not fall with the store-mix shift: each +1pp of lease cost to revenue removes ~RMB55m of annual owner FCF (~12% of the base run-rate)
Inventory markdowns: 407 days of inventory (RMB1.38bn) against a 76% gross margin means a clearance cycle could take 2-3pp off EBITDA margin for a year or two
The RMB650m net cash includes RMB698m of bank/trust wealth management products carried at fair value; if they are less liquid than cash the bridge overstates value by up to RMB1.0/share

Capital allocation: the share award scheme trustee buys ~RMB60-80m of shares a year without cancellation; if grants resume at the FY2024 pace (9.4m shares) the effective SBC charge is above the 1% modelled
Government subsidy income (~RMB75m/yr, 1.2% of revenue) is inside the EBITDA margin and is discretionary to local authorities

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 3.735-8.83. FX from Yahoo CNYHKD=X on the same date.
data_sources.financials: 3709.HK_Metrics.csv and kpis table (core_metrics) built from the FY2018-FY2025 annual reports and H1 FY2024-H1 FY2026 interim reports; balance-sheet anchors (cash, FVTPL, borrowings, lease liabilities, share count) read directly from 3709.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt lines 1880-1912, 2060-2102, 2499-2529, 2844-2852; lease interest, other income and share-award trustee holdings from 3709.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt lines 10244-10262, 10336-10337, 11236-11256, 11712-11724.
data_sources.qualitative: 3709.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-23): business model, brand-level trends, inventory days, store counts, Bain China luxury market data, FY2025 chairman's letter and H1 FY2026 outlook.

inputs.share_count_basis: 669.53m = ordinary shares in issue (708.65m) less ~39m shares held by the 2024 Share Award Scheme trustee, the denominator of both basic and diluted EPS for H1 FY2026 (interim report note, line 2499-2529). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows at ~1% of revenue, and the trustee's open-market purchases (RMB79m FY2025, HK$30.9m H1 FY2026) are the buyback that funds the flat count. If every trustee-held share were granted and vested the count would rise to 708.65m (+5.8%); that cost is what the SBC charge represents.
inputs.cash_note: cash 379.598 + current financial assets at FVTPL (bank/trust wealth management products) 697.751, both at 30 June 2026. Lease liabilities of RMB870.3m (428.9 current + 441.5 non-current) are EXCLUDED from net debt under lease treatment (B).
inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2025 owner FCF = reported FCF 1390.55 - lease principal 857.112 - lease interest 36.92 - SBC 0 - interest income 16.098 = 480.42. FY2025 OCF carried a ~RMB120m working-capital inflow (OCF +56% on a -4.6% revenue year); the component-built normalised figure is ~RMB370-400m, which is what the forward path starts from.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR cash flow statement: equity-settled share award expense nil (6.4m awarded shares forfeited during the year reversed the charge). FY2021-FY2025 charges were 76.1 / 110.5 / 30.7 / 99.5 / 0.0 = RMB63m average = 1.0% of revenue, which anchors the forward sbc_pct_path. Equity-award taxes nil every year (no net-share settlement; awards are satisfied from trustee-bought shares).
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 bank interest 0.629 + other interest income from FVTPL wealth management products 15.469 (AR note 5). Stripped because net cash (RMB647m) exceeds the FCF base; the cash and wealth-management products are added in the bridge instead.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 cash paid by the share award scheme trustee for open-market purchases (ShareRepurchases kpi). H1 FY2026: a further ~4.71m shares for HK$30.85m. No cancellation buyback programme.
inputs.fx_note: CNYHKD=X 1.1742 HKD per CNY, Yahoo Finance, 2026-10-22. Statements and all flows are RMB; the HKEX quote is HKD. Per-share values are computed in RMB and multiplied by fx_rate for the quote-currency headline. No dual listing exists for a parity check; the direction is confirmed by the company's own HK$0.35 final dividend being disclosed as RMB0.30-equivalent in the FY2025 AR (HK$ > RMB per unit).
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-22T08:08:34Z (HKEX regular close 16:08 HKT); 52-week range 3.735-8.83, price sits at the bottom of the range
inputs.wacc_rationale: 9.5% built in RMB: China 10y CGB ~1.8% risk-free, ~6.5% China equity risk premium, beta ~1.1 for a discretionary small-cap apparel retailer gives a ~9.2% cost of equity; bank debt is 9% of equity and immaterial to the blend. No liquidity or cyclicality premium is stacked on top: cyclicality is carried in the scenario flows and the 30% bear weight (risk charged once). Same WACC in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost. The full lease cash (principal RMB857.1m in financing + interest RMB36.9m, FY2025 AR cash flow statement and note 8) is deducted inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path (14.2% of FY2025 revenue); lease liabilities (RMB870.3m at 30 June 2026) are excluded from net debt; D&A is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 RMB116.8m = PP&E depreciation + intangible amortisation, not the RMB865.6m ROU charge). The ebitda_margin_path is therefore the pre-lease (post-IFRS-16, before ROU depreciation) EBITDA ex interest income: FY2025 (679.4 + 865.6 - 16.1) / 6285.8 = 24.3%. Sanity multiples must compare ex-lease EV against EBITDA less lease cash (~RMB650m), never ex-lease EV against the IFRS-16 EBITDA.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is 1.9% of FY2025 net income (RMB8.0m of 405.0m) and the NCI equity stock is negative (-RMB1.9m at FY2025). Immaterial; flows are modelled on the consolidated basis with no NCI deduction. FY0 NOPAT check: modelled FY2025 EBIT ~RMB530m x (1-0.21) = ~RMB420m vs attributable net income RMB397m plus stripped interest/other income - ties within non-operating noise.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 'operating company, non-US / cyclical consumer'), with the adaptations file applied: RMB-built WACC, lease treatment (B), interest income stripped with its source asset (cash + wealth management products) in the bridge, non-current FVTPL investments carried in equity_bridge, SBC kept explicit at a small non-zero rate. This is a shrinking, maturing self-operated store base (1,558 stores FY2021 -> 1,276 June 2026) in a contracting China premium-apparel market (Bain: -3-5% in 2025), so growth paths start negative and recover only to ~2%; the valuation turns on margin durability from cost-cutting and the e-commerce mix shift, not on growth. FY0 = FY2025 (Dec year-end); Y1 = FY2026, for which H1 printed revenue -12.1% and net profit +1.3%. Horizon 10 years because the lease-cost ratio and margins are still moving through year 5. Subsidy income (RMB74.7m FY2025, ~1.2% of revenue, recurring government grants) is left inside the EBITDA margin. Terminal cap 12x per the method's guidance for cyclical / structurally slower businesses. Price is a regular HKEX close, not after-hours.

bear.narrative: Same-store sales keep falling (-17% in self-operated stores in H1 FY2026) and the department-store channel (60% of stores) keeps shrinking faster than mall/outlet flagships can replace it; revenue compounds down to ~RMB4.6bn by FY2031 (-27%). The 407-day inventory forces markdowns, taking the pre-lease margin from 24.5% to 22.5%, while rent is stickier than sales so the lease ratio rises to 15%. Working-capital release cushions cash in the decline years but the run-rate owner FCF ends near RMB200m. Terminal growth 1% (a slowly shrinking store base in nominal RMB). Dividend held only by drawing on the cash pile.

base.narrative: FY2026 revenue -10% (H1 -12.1%, H2 a little better off June's retail inflection), -3% FY2027 as net closures continue, flat FY2028, then 1.5-2% as e-commerce (20% of sales, +12% FY2025) offsets a stable ~1,200-store base. Pre-lease EBITDA margin held at ~25% (FY2025 24.3%; H1 FY2026 ran 28% on cost-cutting but H2 is seasonally ~21-22%). Lease cash drifts from 14.6% to 13.5% of revenue as the mix shifts to fewer, larger mall/outlet flagships and rent-free e-commerce. Net working capital (~21% of revenue, inventory 386 days) releases cash at 15% of each year's revenue decline and absorbs it on recovery. Tax 22% (FY2025 effective 21.1%, PRC statutory 25%).

bull.narrative: China premium-apparel demand recovers in 2027 as Bain's 2025 trough (-3-5%) gives way to the 15th Five-Year Plan consumption push; La Koradior and FUUNNY FEELLN keep growing double digits, the NAERSI integration stops the bleeding in the legacy brands, and Douyin/WeChat Video Channel livestreaming lifts e-commerce past 25% of sales. Revenue returns to 3-4% growth from FY2028, the lease ratio falls to 13% and the pre-lease margin reaches 26.5% as the IMS/AI merchandising tools pull inventory days back under 350. Same WACC as base: risk is in the flows.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default because the evidence in hand is deteriorating, not stabilising: self-operated store revenue -17% in H1 FY2026, inventory days 320 -> 407 over three years, store count down 18% from peak, and every brand except two growth labels declining. Bull cut to 20% because it needs two independent things to go right - a China premium-consumption recovery that Bain has not yet called, and a brand turnaround that management's own 'K-shaped' commentary concedes has not happened in the four legacy brands. Base 50%: cost-cutting has so far held profit flat through a double-digit revenue decline, which is a real and demonstrated lever.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
